config.policy: Small-sky full-survey engineering pilot. All eligible rows within the fixed training cells and frozen fit/select roles, no S/N training cut and no row caps. All 43 QSO slices retain other-redshift competition. Warm-start canonical marginals from the completed full-data candidate; this is a limited-area refit, not an independently trained small-area model. Eight iterations are a fixed pilot budget, not claimed convergence. No downloads, full-production fitting or active-pointer changes.

support_policy.interpretation: conditional density percentile at target redshift; not a class probability
support_policy.scope: Pooled pilot cutoff calibrated on all/Legacy-optical/SDSS/PS1 masks; other masks exploratory

reference_policy_control: same >=5-sigma reference preference in both alternatives
limits: Eight-iteration warm-start small-sky refit; not fully converged production training
QSO abundance inherited; external survey areas approximate
NSC u/VR and VHS H have no pilot measurements; retained inherited coordinates are not empirically certified
Synthetic clean-blend fixtures isolate photometric effects
Test-role data previously inspected during development; not new untouched confirmation
